notes.subject: לזהב לזהב ולכסף לכסף
notes.rationale: Repetition: gold-for-gold, silver-for-silver — kept as repeated phrases.

notes.subject: pulapim han
notes.rationale: למלאות ידו 'fill his hand' = ritual idiom for consecrate/donate freely; KJV 'consecrate his service' smooths it.

notes.subject: husat i redi long pulapim han bilong en
notes.rationale: David's rhetorical question summons the assembly to give; direct challenge.

translation: Gol bilong ol samting bilong gol, na silva bilong ol samting bilong silva, na bilong olgeta wok long han bilong ol wokman; na husat i redi long pulapim han bilong en long dispela de, long Yahwe?

tokens.gloss: na bilong ol samting bilong silva
i redi long givim long laik bilong en yet
